description: Makes the locomotive run around its train at a chosen terminus instead of the game's instant flip. Pick a few points on the map in game; the loco runs round with its own sound, smoke, wheels and paint, reversing where needed, and couples on at the other end facing the right way.
name: Runaround Railways
summary: Your locomotive runs round its train at the terminus instead of the instant flip. Click a few points on the track; it uncouples, runs round with its own sound, smoke and paint, and couples on at the other end.
